page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, left and right, with the running head above them. Left column: entries from נ י to נרפתח. Right column: entries from the end of נר through נשא. The page number is at the top left. No notes, catchwords or signatures.

main_text.l: נָרִי lucerna mea, f. m. aff. No. נֵר; Rad. נוֹר.
נִרְיָה, נָרִיעַ frangemus, fut. Hiph. 1. plur. parag. Rad. רִיעַ, vel רָעַע.
נִרְכַּב equitabimus, fut. Kal, 1. pl. R. רָכַב.
נִרְנָּנָה cantabimus, fut. Piel, 1. plur. parag. Rad. רָנַן.
נִרְעָשָׁה commota est, praet. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. רָעַשׁ.
נִרְפָּא sanatus est, נִרְפְּאוּ sanati sunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. רָפָא.
נִרְפִּים desides, Part. Niph. pl. m. à f.m. נִרְפָּה; Rad. רָפָה remissum esse.
נִרְפָּשׂ conculcatus, Prov. 25.26. (pro נִרְפָּס,) Part. Niph. f. m. Rad. רָפַס.
נִרְפָּתָּח curata est, Jer. 51. 9. (qu. à Rad. רָפָא, pro נִרְפְּאָה,) praet. Niph.
נִרְצָה acceptatus est, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. R. רָצָה.
נִרְצָחָה occisa, Part. Niph. f. f. R. רָצַח.
נִרְתֵיכֶם lucerna tua, נִרְתֵּךְ eorum, pl. f. aff. No. f. m. נֵר; Rad. נוֹר.
נִשָּׂה recensere, מְנַשֵּׂא prae condonare, Infin. Kal, præf. Rad. נָשָׂא.
נָשׂא luxando, Jer. 23.39. (pro נָשֹׁה,) Infin. Kal; Rad. נָשָׁה oblitus est.
נָשׂוּא vel נָשׂא honoratus, (pro נָשׁוּא,) Paul Kal, f. m. Rad. נָשָׂא tulit.
נְשָׂא extolle, Imper. Piel, f. m. R. נָשָׂא.
נָשָׂא attolle, Pf. 10. 12. Imper. Kal, f. m. R. נָשָׂא.
נָשָׂא sublatus est, sublatus, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. vel Part. Niph. f. m. Rad. נשא

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some letters are faint, especially in the left column around נִרְכַּב, נִרְנָּנָה and נִרְעָשָׁה, where a grey smudge covers the lines. Those forms and the pointing of several right-column entries are doubtful and may need checking against the scan. The Latin abbreviations are copied as printed. The letter headings נ י and נ ש are set as paragraphs, not headings, because they are bare letters. The two Hebrew running-head letters at the top are copied as printed.
